title: Demise of Ashur-uballit II, last king of Assyria
summary: The last Assyrian king, Ashur-uballit II, is defeated at Harran, ending the Assyrian Empire.
description: The last Assyrian king, Ashur-uballit II, is defeated at Harran, ending the Assyrian Empire. Recorded from a CFAH OSF preprint anchor point (not yet published in ARJ). Added by the CFAH pass.
